known_announcements.title: TWITTER 값 지원종료 예정 — 멤버/연락체 API messenger 타입 필드 (2026-11~12월)
known_announcements.summary: The TWITTER value in the messenger type field of member and contact APIs will be removed. Korean docs target: mid-November 2026; Japanese docs target: early December 2026. The value was already renamed to X in the July 2026 core update; this notice tracks the final removal. Additionally, zipCode max length will change to 20 in early December 2026. Reported in GitHub issue #40.

known_announcements.title: LINE WORKS Developers 개발자 뉴스 — HTTP/1.0 지원종료 및 응답 헤더 소문자화 (2026-08-28)
known_announcements.summary: Breaking changes: (1) HTTP/1.0 support removed for token issuance, LINE WORKS API, and SSO — callers must use HTTP/1.1+. (2) Response header field names changed to all-lowercase. (3) AiNote: summary property no longer includes AI-generated summaries from late August 2026; summaries property added instead. (4) Bot: join/joined callbacks will stop firing for 1:1 Bot talk rooms in early December 2026. Reported in GitHub issue #43.

known_announcements.title: LINE WORKS Developers 지원종료 기능 목록 — Directory/SSO/OIDC/Drive (2026년 12월 예정)
known_announcements.summary: Multiple deprecations effective December 2026: (1) Directory user management APIs deprecated, replace with User Custom Property API. (2) SSO IdP-initiated logout via POST planned for removal. (3) OIDC jwks_uri public key modulus (n) Base64 padding '=' removal per RFC 7515 (announced 2026-10-16). (4) Drive shared-drive access permission feature end-of-service. Reported in GitHub issue #44.
